articles.title: Hyperliquid’s RWA perps boom is eating into the revenue that backs HYPE
articles.snippet: Revenue has fallen four quarters running while open interest hit a record high. The gap is a fee-sharing program that hands half the platform's volume to outside builders.

articles.title: Bitcoin investors pour $853 million into spot ETFs. BlackRock’s IBIT claims the bulk
articles.snippet: Bitcoin ETFs recorded $853.54 million in net inflows last week, the strongest since mid-April, with BlackRock’s IBIT taking the bulk.

articles.title: Crypto is going through a massive dot-com style shakeout as over 100 projects fold in 2026
articles.snippet: An industry-wide reckoning is weeding out unsustainable startups, leaving behind only the protocols with real cash flow and actual users.

articles.title: Controversial Bitcoin fork BIP-110 mines two blocks, then stops
articles.snippet: The breakaway chain inherited bitcoin’s mining difficulty with only a tiny share of hashpower, leaving blocks hours apart while both chains still accept the same transactions.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits block 961,632 as the controversial BIP-110 soft fork attempt begins
articles.snippet: The proposal has scant support from bitcoin miners and influential commentators have also voiced their opposition.
